# InternPrep AI

> InternPrep AI is a high-performance interview simulation and resume intelligence platform calibrated to premier campus placements (IIT Bombay) and top-tier corporate recruitment standards.

## Core Capabilities
- **Live Case & Domain Interview Simulation**: Real-time simulated interviews covering 5 distinct domains (Management Consulting, Software & Systems SWE, Data Science & Analytics, Finance & Valuation, Product Management). Includes dynamic follow-ups, whiteboard calculation parsing, and automated rubric scoring.
- **Resume Intelligence & ATS Diagnostic Engine**: Sub-second deterministic and neural ATS resume auditing, section-by-section breakdown, metric density calculation, and high-agency action verb enhancement.
- **Achievement Vault & Point Bank**: Structured STAR-format achievement formulation with automated metric quantification and bullet point refinement.
- **Placement Analysis & Company Intelligence**: Historical campus placement statistics, shortlisted candidate GPA bands, cutoff profiles, and compensation distributions across 100+ premier recruiters.

## Regulatory & Legal Architecture
- **Data Fiduciary**: InternPrep AI Technologies Pvt. Ltd., Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400051, India.
- **Compliance Standards**: India Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, EU GDPR, PCI-DSS Level 1 (via Razorpay).
- **AI Ethics & Privacy**: User resumes, audio transcripts, and interview responses are NEVER used to train foundation models. All inference is stateless and purged post-session.
- **Grievance Redressal**: Official Grievance Redressal Officer reachable at grievance@internprep.ai.
- **Customer Support**: support@internprep.ai.

- [ATS Scorecard Studio](https://internprep.ai/ats-checker): Quick ATS score checker.
- [Placement Intelligence](https://internprep.ai/placement-analysis): Company-specific historical cutoffs and salary data.
- [Privacy Policy](https://internprep.ai/privacy): Statutory privacy disclosures under DPDP Act 2023.

- [Cookie Policy](https://internprep.ai/cookies): Breakdown of essential and telemetry storage.
